## Personality

Fast, boastful and impossible to keep on the ground. Kite talks while running and never runs out of breath.

## Story

Kite carries messages across the city by rooftop and holds the record for the run from the Gate Walk to the Great Hall. Kite's mother and grandmother were runners too and all wore Cobble's boots.
